name: One motif
status: built, checks run, awaiting owner review

motif.shape: The blue quarter-arc of the Bellis 'b': a 90-degree ring segment (outer radius R, inner radius 0.64R, as in the logo).
motif.why: It is the brand's own mark and it is also the subject's most made object: a lagged 90-degree pipe elbow, the cladding piece Bellis fabricates. One clause: the logo's arc is a pipe bend.
motif.checked_against: Tested against the subject's other simple geometry (the full ring of a pipe section, the straight band of a jacket). The quarter-arc wins because it is in the logo and reads as a bend; the client's circle-cropped range tiles were avoided wherever possible because circles would be a second shape.
where_it_runs: Hero of every page: the giant ring, flat oxblood, drawn as one stroke that bends into place on load, with the page's photograph in its hole as the logo's bowl sits in its arc
Every photograph, tab, button, chip, tile and panel: square corners plus one full-radius bend at the top right (radius = the frame's shorter side, via a 9999px corner)
The bend mark: the quarter-ring at text size beside list titles, job titles, branch names, errors
The services field and the closing band: a giant bend on their top-right corner
The mobile menu opens from the Menu button's corner as a growing quadrant
The closing arrow is a bent arrow; the footer letters are knocked out of bent blocks

deviations.what: Palette kept as dealt (oxblood #7d0c14 on grey #e2e2e2); the logo blue is not the action colour.
deviations.why: The sheet's palette uses one hue for ink, accent and field, so it cannot carry the blue without a second accent. The logo stays blue in the header. Owner decides; a blue version is a swap of --da-ink, --da-accent, --da-fill and their muted, press and raise steps (for example navy #275787 or deep blue #036AAA on the same grey).

deviations.what: Hero copy roles: h1 is copy.home.eyebrow ('Mechanical insulation for heavy industry'); the supporting sentence is copy.home.headline; copy.home.lede moved to the statement section directly under the hero.
deviations.why: The gate FAILs eyebrow labels and headlines over two lines, and the 78-character headline cannot hold two lines at display size in columns 1-6 (the display face measures 0.44 em per character). All three deck strings still show, in order.

deviations.what: Home h1 at 4.25vw (61px at 1440), not 6.4vw; set in weight 300, not heavy.
deviations.why: Column 1-6 width; the type sheet (one weight, 300) outranks the hero blueprint. Products and contact titles are short and run at the sheet's 6.4vw.

deviations.what: The giant shape is cropped by the right edge, the hero's bottom and the hero's top (under the sticky header) rather than the viewport top, and holds the hero photograph in its hole.
deviations.why: The header sits on bare ground so its links stay legible on every page; the brief requires a hero picture and the direction puts photographs inside the motif. The ring rests on the hero's baseline as the logo's arc does.

deviations.what: Shutter-image runs on the jobs photograph (below the fold), not on the hero picture.
deviations.why: Motion must not hide above-the-fold content. The hero instead draws its ring (a decorative shape) on load.

deviations.what: Work blueprint (stacked folders) used for the nine services as a 3x3 grid of folder tabs on the oxblood field, not four to six sticky full-height bands.
deviations.why: Nine services in 80svh bands would take about seven screens; the tab-on-folder geometry is kept.

deviations.what: Intro statement at 34px on desktop and 21px on phone, not up to 62px and 8vw.
deviations.why: The gate allows a three-line statement only at 36px or less on desktop and treats 22px+ text on a phone as a heading.

deviations.what: Features points: body at 19px in full ink, not 15px soft ink.
Contact coupon holds seven fields with visible labels and the need choice as picture radio tiles in the stub; notches stay semicircles.
deviations.why: The brief's form has seven fields and validation needs visible labels; the notches are the coupon's functional cue, the one curve that is not the motif.

deviations.what: Closing band word is 'Enquire' (from copy.actions.enquire), with copy.home.closingTitle and closingBody top-left.
deviations.why: The only one-word verb in the deck; it spans the content width at 25.5vw, inside the blueprint's 24-30vw.

deviations.what: Footer mark reduced to a 20svh sign-off.
deviations.why: Look round: at 34svh it competed with the closing word directly above it.

deviations.what: Scroll entrances below 1000px rise 16px without fading.
deviations.why: Content is never hidden on a phone or tablet, so a fast flick never meets a blank band and full-page captures are complete.

deviations.what: Two client range tiles imported from assets/own/tiles/.
deviations.why: Mastics and specialty have no deck picture; the brief names tiles for the product ranges. The lead should confirm the import, or they become placeholders.

deviations.what: Navigation: Products, Services (home#services), Contact, the phone number, and the action. The header action hides while the page's own action is on screen.
deviations.why: Only three pages exist; the action shows exactly once on every screen.
